push_module_to_hub: push an evaluation module to the Hugging Face Hub as a Gradio space with a given commit hash and optional tag
get_git_tag: get the git tag associated with a commit hash in the evaluate library repository
update_evaluate_dependency: update the evaluate dependency in a requirements file with a specific commit hash
copy_recursive: copy a directory recursively from a source path to a target path overwriting existing files
run_push_evaluations: run the script to push all evaluation modules from metrics, comparisons, and measurements folders to the Hugging Face Hub
